summary: Tested Private Room persistent lobby system. Room creation, lobby chat, mic status, and game buttons work correctly. Fixed missing roomPartner destructuring bug in PrivateRoom.js. Room games require both players to be connected (expected behavior). Backend APIs pass all tests (10/10).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: PrivateRoom.js was missing roomPartner destructuring from useRoomLobby() - this would cause undefined errors when passing partnerUsername to game components
Room game start requires both players to have active socket connections (get_live_user_payload checks active_user_sockets) - this is correct behavior
Room lobby chat uses context_type='room' which correctly routes messages through room context
Room voice uses audio-only mode (mediaMode='audio-only') to keep mic active without camera duplication
Match.js correctly navigates back to /private-room when privateRoomLaunch is true on skip/end

success_rate.frontend: 90% (UI loads correctly, room creation works, lobby chat visible, game buttons present)

test_credentials.guest: Created dynamically via /api/auth/guest with username and gender

context_for_next_testing_agent: Private Room lobby system is functional. Room creation works for premium users. Lobby chat and mic status indicators are visible. Game buttons (UNO, Feud, Draw) are present but require 2 connected players to start. The roomPartner bug was fixed. To fully test room games, need two browser sessions with different users connected to the same room.
